# COSLUS

> > Professional home beauty and oral care tools with advanced technology, free shipping, and 2-year warranty coverage.

COSLUS specializes in cordless, rechargeable personal care devices including water flossers, electric nail drills, and sonic facial brushes. The brand emphasizes portability, waterproof design (IPX7 rated), and multi-speed customization across its product lines.

## Key Topics

- Water Flosser
- Oral Irrigator
- Nail Drill
- Facial Cleanser
- Cordless & Rechargeable
- IPX7 Waterproof
- Teeth Cleaning
- Manicure & Pedicure
- Sonic Technology
- USB-C Charging
- Multiple Speed Settings
- Travel Portable
- Professional Beauty Tools
- Dental Hygiene
- Acrylic & Gel Polish Removal

## Water Flossers & Oral Care

- [Oral Care Collection](https://www.coslus.com/collections/oral-care): Complete water flosser collection featuring E40, C20, C30, C31 models with varying speed and pressure settings
- [COSLUS E40 Water Flosser](https://www.coslus.com/products/wfp14-water-flosser): 10-speed professional oral irrigator with stepless pressure dial, ideal for braces and sensitive gums, 300ml cordless design
- [COSLUS C20 Cordless Water Flosser](https://www.coslus.com/products/water-dental-flosser-300ml-for-teeth-cleaning-ipx7): Best-selling portable water flosser with IPX7 waterproof rating, 300ml capacity, rechargeable for travel
- [COSLUS C30 Advanced Water Flosser](https://www.coslus.com/products/fc5360-water-dental-flosser): 4-mode water flosser with DIY custom pressure and dual-thread stream for deep cleaning and plaque removal
- [COSLUS T40 Mini Travel Water Flosser](https://www.coslus.com/products/t40wfp17-mini-water-dental-flosser): Collapsible pocket-size oral irrigator with telescopic tank, USB-C charging for on-the-go teeth cleaning

## Electric Nail Care Tools

- [Nail Care Collection](https://www.coslus.com/collections/nail-care): Professional nail drill selection including cordless models C20, C40, C30, C41 for manicure and pedicure
- [COSLUS C20 Cordless Nail Drill](https://www.coslus.com/products/nail-drill-new-release): Portable 5-speed electric nail drill for acrylic and gel polish removal with rechargeable battery
- [COSLUS C40 Electric Nail File Machine](https://www.coslus.com/products/fb10-nail-drill): Beginner-friendly USB portable e-file with dual direction control for thick toenails and shaping
- [COSLUS C30 Electric Manicure & Pedicure Set](https://www.coslus.com/products/8-in-1-electric-manicure-and-pedicure-kit): 5-in-1 nail care system with LED light and multiple attachments for natural nails and cuticles
- [COSLUS C41 Professional Manicure Pedicure Kit](https://www.coslus.com/products/coslus-c41-professional-manicure-pedicure-kit-copy): 8-piece professional nail grooming kit with powerful drill for men and women, includes travel case

- [Skin Care Collection](https://www.coslus.com/collections/skin-care): Professional facial care tools including brushes P2017, FBX04, FBS03 for cleansing and massage
- [P2017 Facial Power Brush Set](https://www.coslus.com/products/p2017-facial-power-brush-with-7-brush-heads): Facial power brush with 7 interchangeable brush heads for customized skincare routines
- [COSLUS FBS01 Sonic Silicone Face Scrubber](https://www.coslus.com/products/fbs01-portable-silicone-facial-cleanser): Portable sonic silicone facial cleanser designed for sensitive skin, waterproof and rechargeable
- [COSLUS FBS03 Self-Foaming Sonic Facial Brush](https://www.coslus.com/products/l6-foaming-silicone-facial-cleanser): Electric foaming silicone face cleanser and massager with heated mode for better absorption
